android.desc:
Take control of your personal finance journey with Money to Wealth—the ultimate offline expense tracker, budget planner, and net worth manager. 

Whether you want to track daily spending, build an emergency runway, or monitor your real estate and stock investments, Money to Wealth gives you a complete picture of your net worth in one unified, distraction-free experience.

🔒 100% OFFLINE & PRIVATE
Your financial data belongs exclusively to you. Money to Wealth operates entirely on your hardware:
• Zero cloud servers or databases
• No bank logins or account creation required
• 100% local storage on your device
• Manual export to Excel or JSON anytime for offline backups

🎮 LEVEL UP YOUR FINANCES
Managing money should not feel like doing chores. Money to Wealth gamifies your financial habits:
• Earn XP and build daily tracking streaks
• Unlock levels and milestones as your savings grow
• Master practical financial ratios (50/30/20) and debt payoff targets

💰 CORE FEATURES
• Smart Expense Tracking: Log income, expenses, and transfers in seconds with intuitive macro-buckets.
• Full Balance Sheet & Net Worth: Go beyond simple budgeting. Monitor cash, stocks, mutual funds, gold, real estate, and fixed deposits in one clean dashboard.
• Realized P&L: Mark assets as sold to instantly calculate your profit and loss.
• Debt & Goal Pods: Manage credit cards and loans while tracking dedicated savings pods for emergency funds and long-term targets.
• Smart Statement Import: Avoid tedious manual entry by importing standard CSV or Excel bank statements locally.
• Long-Term Projections: View 10-year net worth forecasts, historical trend charts, and category breakdowns.

🌍 BUILT FOR COMPLETE FLEXIBILITY
Money to Wealth supports multiple global currencies and dynamic number formatting, making it effortless to track your wealth regardless of your local currency.

Ready to build long-term financial clarity on your own terms? Download Money to Wealth today and take full control of your net worth!
